facts.fact: 梦的落点：Jessica 梦见房屋中心有「既可怕又美妙」的东西，醒来时仍未抵达
facts.anchor: There was something at the heart of the house, something both terrible and wonderful, something that would solve all her problems and make her whole, she was certain of it, but she could not recall what it was when she awoke. She only knew that she had not yet reached it.

facts.fact: Jessica 觉得 Molly 某处像 Morgan McKinley，由此揭开少女时代的记忆长流
facts.anchor: She kind of looks like Morgan McKinley, thought Jessica. Something about the intense eyes and the crooked smile.

facts.fact: 教会中学时期父母搜出违禁品：圣经之外的书、大麻、与 Morgan 交换的照片
facts.anchor: Her parents would never have dreamed that their daughter harbored a secret life outside the home until the day they discovered the reality. They were livid to learn that Jessica had been polluting her mind with literature outside the bible, that her imagination had been quietly growing in secret for years, that she now enjoyed fantasies of which her parents could never even dream. There was other contraband too. A baggie of weed, and photographs Jessica had traded with Morgan McKinley.

facts.fact: 决裂点：母亲收回女儿身份的一句话
facts.anchor: I thought you were my daughter, her mother had said. But I don’t know you.

facts.fact: Morgan 用「枕边话」一句打碎 Jessica 的出逃幻想
facts.anchor: You know that was all pillow talk, Jess. Be real. Go home.

facts.fact: Sandy 在没有祖父母的环境中长大，缺席显得理所当然
facts.anchor: Sandy had grown up in a house without grandparents, so their absence seemed natural and did not bear remark.

facts.fact: Sandy 提出房子有问题后，Molly 打翻水壶，滚水泼地
facts.anchor: CLANG. Molly dropped the kettle to the floor; boiling hot water spilled across the linoleum and Molly hopped backward with a cry.

facts.fact: Molly 披露 Helena Hollyoak 是广受喜爱的儿童奇幻作家，并报出三部作品名
facts.anchor: By some accounts, she was as popular as Enid Blyton or Beatrix Potter, and her characters were as famous as Asterix or even Tintin. She wrote Robert the Bobby, The Stealthy Seven, and Wimbly Withershins.
